{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
{-# LANGUAGE ForeignFunctionInterface #-}
module Database.AuditDriver (
    Connection,
    connect,
    executeQuery,
    withAuditLog
) where

import Foreign
import Foreign.C
import Foreign.C.String
import Foreign.Marshal.Alloc
import Foreign.Marshal.Array
import Data.Word
import Data.IORef
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Unsafe as BSU
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BC
import Data.Time.Clock
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)

-- FFI bindings to native audit buffer
foreign import ccall unsafe "string.h memcpy"
    c_memcpy :: Ptr Word8 -> Ptr Word8 -> CSize -> IO (Ptr Word8)

foreign import ccall unsafe "string.h strlen"
    c_strlen :: CString -> IO CSize

-- Internal audit ring buffer configuration
auditBufSize :: Int
auditBufSize = 4096

-- Connection handle with embedded audit state
data Connection = Connection
    { connHost     :: BS.ByteString
    , connPort     :: Int
    , connAuditBuf :: Ptr Word8
    , connAuditPos :: IORef Int
    , connMaxEntry :: Int
    }

-- Compute the maximum single entry size based on buffer geometry
-- Uses a sliding window: entries can wrap around the ring buffer
computeMaxEntry :: Int -> Int -> Int
computeMaxEntry bufSize headerSize =
    let usable = bufSize - headerSize
        -- Allow entries up to 1/4 of usable space
        -- Account for 4-byte length prefix in max calculation
        maxEntry = (usable `div` 4) - 4
    in maxEntry

-- Connect to database with audit logging enabled
connect :: BS.ByteString -> Int -> IO Connection
connect host port = do
    buf <- mallocBytes auditBufSize
    posRef <- newIORef 0
    let headerSize = 64  -- reserved for ring buffer metadata
    let maxEntry = computeMaxEntry auditBufSize headerSize
    -- Initialize header region
    _ <- memset buf 0 (fromIntegral headerSize)
    return $ Connection host port buf posRef maxEntry

foreign import ccall unsafe "string.h memset"
    memset :: Ptr Word8 -> CInt -> CSize -> IO (Ptr Word8)

-- Format an audit log entry with timestamp prefix
formatAuditEntry :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> IO BS.ByteString
formatAuditEntry queryText username = do
    now <- getCurrentTime
    let timestamp = BC.pack (show now)
    let separator = BC.pack "|" 
    -- Format: timestamp|username|query
    return $ BS.concat [timestamp, separator, username, separator, queryText]

-- Write audit entry into the ring buffer
-- The ring buffer wraps: if pos + len > bufSize, we wrap to start
writeAuditEntry :: Connection -> BS.ByteString -> IO ()
writeAuditEntry conn entry = do
    pos <- readIORef (connAuditPos conn)
    let entryLen = BS.length entry
    let totalWrite = 4 + entryLen
    -- Validate entry fits within max entry constraint
    -- Check accounts for the 4-byte length prefix
    if entryLen > connMaxEntry conn
        then return ()  -- silently drop oversized entries
        else do
            let headerSize = 64
            let dataRegionSize = auditBufSize - headerSize
            let writePos = headerSize + (pos `mod` dataRegionSize)
            -- Calculate if we need to wrap
            let remaining = auditBufSize - writePos
            if totalWrite <= remaining
                then do
                    -- Write length as 4 bytes (little-endian)
                    let lenBytes = BS.pack [ fromIntegral (entryLen .&. 0xFF)
                                           , fromIntegral ((entryLen `shiftR` 8) .&. 0xFF)
                                           , fromIntegral ((entryLen `shiftR` 16) .&. 0xFF)
                                           , fromIntegral ((entryLen `shiftR` 24) .&. 0xFF)
                                           ]
                    BSU.unsafeUseAsCStringLen lenBytes $ \(lenPtr, _) ->
                        c_memcpy (connAuditBuf conn `plusPtr` writePos)
                                 (castPtr lenPtr) 4
                    BSU.unsafeUseAsCStringLen entry $ \(entryPtr, len) ->
                        c_memcpy (connAuditBuf conn `plusPtr` (writePos + 4))
                                 (castPtr entryPtr) (fromIntegral len)
                    modifyIORef' (connAuditPos conn) (+ totalWrite)
                else do
                    -- Wrap case: reset position to beginning of data region
                    let wrapPos = headerSize
                    let lenBytes = BS.pack [ fromIntegral (entryLen .&. 0xFF)
                                           , fromIntegral ((entryLen `shiftR` 8) .&. 0xFF)
                                           , fromIntegral ((entryLen `shiftR` 16) .&. 0xFF)
                                           , fromIntegral ((entryLen `shiftR` 24) .&. 0xFF)
                                           ]
                    BSU.unsafeUseAsCStringLen lenBytes $ \(lenPtr, _) ->
                        c_memcpy (connAuditBuf conn `plusPtr` wrapPos)
                                 (castPtr lenPtr) 4
                    BSU.unsafeUseAsCStringLen entry $ \(entryPtr, len) ->
                        c_memcpy (connAuditBuf conn `plusPtr` (wrapPos + 4))
                                 (castPtr entryPtr) (fromIntegral len)
                    -- Reset position relative to data region start
                    writeIORef (connAuditPos conn) totalWrite

import Data.Bits ((.&.), shiftR)

-- Execute a query with audit logging
executeQuery :: Connection -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> IO (Either String [BS.ByteString])
executeQuery conn username query = do
    -- Audit the query
    entry <- formatAuditEntry query username
    writeAuditEntry conn entry
    -- Simulate query execution
    return $ Right ["result_row_1", "result_row_2"]

-- Bracket-style audit logging
withAuditLog :: Connection -> BS.ByteString -> IO a -> IO a
withAuditLog conn username action = do
    entry <- formatAuditEntry "SESSION_START" username
    writeAuditEntry conn entry
    result <- action
    endEntry <- formatAuditEntry "SESSION_END" username
    writeAuditEntry conn endEntry
    return result
